entries.zh: 遗：遗留；遗产、遗业（herencia 遗产，heredar 继承、遗留）
entries.en: inheritance, legacy; to inherit, to leave behind

entries.zh: 手尾：死者身后留下的遗物、遗产；余剩之物
entries.en: personal effects/estate left by the deceased (lit. 'hand-tail'); inheritance
entries.notes: L 栏含上标互见缩写 ᴮ，展开依赖推断；'遗物遗产'义由 H/M 栏互证。

entries.zh: 得手尾：承受（死者的）遗产、接收遗物
entries.en: to receive the inheritance; to take over the deceased's effects
entries.notes: 首字有〔疑：得/浔〕标注且 ᴮ 缩写待展开；'承受遗产'义由得＋手尾组合推出。

entries.zh: 遗下：身后遗留、留下（财产）
entries.en: to leave behind after death; to bequeath

entries.zh: 遗业：遗下的产业、家业（遗产）

entries.notes: L 栏 'tenal de' 词形残损难解（疑为词组截断），释义以 H/M 栏'伤'为准。

entries.zh: 疮：疮伤、溃疡；泛指任何伤口（llaga）
entries.en: sore, ulcer; any kind of wound
entries.notes: M 栏后半音写污损（T99），'疮'义依 L/H 栏互证。

entries.zh: 枪口（枪喙）：矛、枪刺出的伤口，枪眼
entries.en: lance/spear wound; wound made by a spear-thrust
entries.notes: 首字〔疑：鎗/銓〕且 M 栏后段污损（T99）；'枪伤'义依 L 栏 herida de lança。

entries.zh: 捾一空：戳出一个窟窿——被推刺而成的创口
entries.notes: 首字〔疑：捾/捍〕、M 栏 T99；'戳孔'义由'一空'组合与 empujón（推刺）互证。

entries.en: to be wounded; to suffer an injury from a blow
knife wound; to wound with a knife

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕——疑为伤口上结的硬痂、脓痂（L 栏 materia＝脓物）
entries.en: 〔Original damaged, gloss uncertain〕— probably hard crust/scab over a wound (materia: purulent matter)
entries.notes: L 栏文字严重残损难解，H 栏'重壳運'末字污损（T99）；'痂壳'仅为推断。

entries.zh: 抓一空：抓破一个孔——抓伤、抓破的创口
entries.en: scratch wound (lit. 'scratch out a hole'); wound made by clawing
entries.notes: 首字〔疑：抓/抔〕、M 栏 T99；'抓破成孔'依组合义与 L 栏（疑为 arañadura'抓痕'之讹）。
M 栏声调号污损（T99），但'打＝击打'义由 L/H 栏互证清晰。

entries.zh: 琢：以物自上掷下击打；琢成空——击破成孔。例：用棍棒掷击
entries.en: to hit (someone) with something dropped from above; to knock (a hole) — e.g. with a stick let fall
to strike and wound someone; to injure with a blow

entries.zh: 成空：打破成孔——（打人）破皮成创口
entries.en: to break open into a hole; to wound so as to break the skin
entries.notes: M 栏 T99；'成孔'义依同页'一空＝孔'之用法与 L 栏 herir a alguno。

entries.zh: 琢成空：以棒掷击、击破成孔
entries.en: to strike with a stick (let fall) so as to knock a hole
entries.notes: M 栏 T99；义承第 15 条'琢'（R 栏 ex: con palo soltando lo 同指）。

entries.zh: 伤人：伤害人、打伤人；疑亦指以恶言伤人
entries.en: to hurt/injure people; possibly to abuse with bad words (source garbled)
entries.notes: M 栏 T99 且 L 栏 'malos pala bexas' 残损难解（或为 malas palabras），'伤人'义依 H 栏。
